places.w: Charcoal grill restaurant on Appleton's west side, open since 2006, with all-you-can-eat Alaskan whitefish and broiled haddock on Fridays and hand-breaded perch and haddock daily.
East Appleton restaurant in a building opened in 1948, family run since 1967, whose all-day Friday menu includes all-you-can-eat batter-fried Icelandic haddock and fresh lake perch.
Long-running Appleton steakhouse and piano bar owned by the Quimby family since 1976, offering about ten different Friday fish fry specials with Boston clam chowder.
Downtown Appleton neighborhood bar with a Friday fish fry of Icelandic haddock, hand-battered perch and breaded walleye served with marble rye and coleslaw.

places.n: The Red Ox Seafood and Steakhouse
places.w: Appleton seafood and steakhouse listed among Fox Valley supper clubs, known for haddock prepared many different ways.
East-side Appleton sports bar that serves its fish fry all day on Fridays.
Menasha neighborhood tavern dating to the early 1940s, sold to new owners in 2026, that serves a Wednesday through Friday fish fry of perch, pike and haddock with its house sweet coleslaw.
Menasha bar, grill and supper club whose Friday fish dinners include all-you-can-eat hand-breaded haddock and lake perch with the soup and salad bar.
Family-owned bar and grill west of Menasha, in business for over 32 years, with a Friday fish menu of perch, bluegill and fried or broiled haddock.
Town of Menasha pub established in 1998 whose Friday fish fry menu offers lake perch, Icelandic haddock, bluegill and walleye pike dinners.
Family-owned banquet hall and supper club near Black Creek since 1963 that runs an all-you-can-eat Friday buffet with broiled and deep-fried haddock and deep-fried pollock.
Combined Locks supper club opened on November 1, 1965, with a Friday night fish menu of perch and haddock dinners and seafood platters served with coleslaw.
Family-owned Hollandtown restaurant and banquet hall dating to 1848, known for family-style broasted chicken and a Friday seafood menu of cod, walleye and lake perch.
Kimberly supper club serving the Fox Valley since 1972 with a soup and salad bar, Saturday smoked prime rib and a seafood list of perch, bluegill, walleye and haddock.
Neenah restaurant and sports bar off Interstate 41 whose weekly specials include a Friday fish fry of lake perch, fried haddock or a seafood combo.

Family-owned Sherwood supper club with more than 60 years of history, known for its soup and salad bar, Saturday prime rib and a Friday fish fry of deep-fried or steamed haddock plus rotating fish specials.
